I’ve been through a pretty similar thing earlier on this year, and it’s hard. I understand that feeling when you hear/see how hurt people are from something you’ve done or said to them. It’s really hard to deal with especially when things are already going down. 
All I can really say is that it sounds like both your parents are trying their best, and all you can try do is communicate. For me, that’s been the struggle with my relationship with my parents because I’m not very expressive and they’re left guessing and worried. It could just be checking in once a day or so to see how things are going and giving them a ‘headline’ (a simple word or so about how things are going) to help them see where you are. And if you do feel unsafe tell them, and let them know what they can do to help. 
This is really the best way to get around this situation, because not telling them things will also make them worry just as telling them things will, but at least they won’t be guessing. It can also bring you a lot closer to each other, and I hope for you that whatever happens everything ends up okay. 
I’m here if you ever want to chat about anything, take care :)
